title: Mere baare mein
bio:
Main Abdullah Khan hoon, Karachi se freelance web developer, digital marketer aur graphic designer. Poora kaam main khud karta hoon: website, woh ads jo logon ko website tak laayen, aur woh visuals jo dono ko ek hi business jaisa dikhayen.

IT ke courses maine chhoti umar se shuru kiye aur seekhna kabhi band nahi kiya. Freelancing se pehle main sales, quality assurance aur Node.js development mein kaam kar chuka hoon.
rolesValue: Web developer (front end aur full stack), digital marketer, graphic designer aur brand strategist.
workedValue: Sales, quality assurance aur Node.js development mein.
buildValue: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Node aur Express, MongoDB, Supabase, Firebase, Git, REST APIs.
adsValue: Meta Ads, TikTok Promote, Instagram aur Facebook marketing, lead generation aur reporting.
createValue: Graphic design, UI aur UX, CapCut mein chhoti videos aur AI ki madad se creative kaam.
studiedValue: Modern Web Application Development, Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT) se.
handleValue: AbdullahKhan_369. Is mein 369 Nikola Tesla ko ek salaam hai.
